title: GLIMPSE: Holistic Cross-Modal Explainability for Large Generative Vision–Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation using the GLIMPSE cross-modal saliency mapping framework to generate spatial heatmaps, revealing the model's algorithmic tendency to over-attend to prominent or 'default' visual objects (e.g., sinks, light fixtures) while ignoring less common but semantically critical visual evidence.
